exposure: Large AC group vs control group
Macrosomic infants in large AC group vs macrosomic infants in control group
cohort: 501 term singleton infants with prenatal diagnosis of large AC (>= 360 mm) and matched controls.
finding: Infants with large AC had a higher incidence of macrosomia, hypoglycemia, and significant morbidity, but no increase in congenital malformations or other perinatal complications.
